SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERSTATUS_CCD] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
AS(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
	SELECT 
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_STATUS AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId 

FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD
WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

    SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_STATUS AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
	,BCD.BNK_CODE  AS FinancialInstitutionId 
 FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
 WHERE BCD.ISLATEST = 1
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerStatusTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCECODE
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerStatusTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCECODE
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW  IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31'



-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

END
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERSTATUS_SEC] AS
BEGIN
WITH
TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED
AS
(
    SELECT BSC.CLTCODE, BSA.DATE_OPEN, BSA.ACCTCODE  FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLACCOUNTS BSA 
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_ACCOUNTLINK BSL ON BSA.ACCTCODE = BSL.ACCTKEY AND BSA.ISLATEST = 1 AND BSL.ISLATEST = 1
    JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSL.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
)
,
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus
AS(
	SELECT 
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,CASE WHEN BSC.LASTUPDATED IS NULL
          THEN GDC.DATE_OPEN   
          ELSE BSC.LASTUPDATED END AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BSC.STATUS AS CustomerStatusTypeId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCECODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC
LEFT JOIN TMP_GET_DATE_CREATED GDC ON BSC.CLTCODE = GDC.CLTCODE
WHERE  BSC.ISLATEST = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerStatusTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCECODE
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerId)
,convert(varchar,CustomerStatusTypeId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, FinancialInstitutionId, SOURCECODE
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND SourceCode = 'SEC'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW  IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.CustomerStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC
 ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC';

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerStatus  ( 
CustomerId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerStatusNote
,CustomerStatusTypeId
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerStatusNote
,SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId AS CustomerStatusTypeId
,SRC.SOURCECODE
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerStatus_DELTA;

END
GO
